constraints_found.constraint: Craving: noodles (Liam's noodle stall on the noodle row). Every venue card is noodles, so it does not separate any of them.
constraints_found.source_line: liam: "the noodle stall, the one nobody could find all summer ... she swears it's on the noodle row"

constraints_found.constraint: Budget: $ (Maya's coin purse is the whole budget; she won't break a bill)
constraints_found.source_line: maya: "my coin purse is the whole budget tonight. if a price board makes me break a bill, i will be very dramatic about it"

constraints_found.constraint: Peanut allergy, a deal-breaker. That includes peanut oil in the wok and peanuts sprinkled on top (implied by the satay incident).
constraints_found.source_line: liam: "cross off any cart with peanut in it. wok oil, sprinkled on top, all of it. one satay incident was plenty"

constraints_found.constraint: Brooke's preference: light, green, not fried or greasy
constraints_found.source_line: brooke: "a bowl that's actually green and doesn't leave me feeling like a fried dumpling" (set up by her grandma line about eating greens)

constraints_found.constraint: Roxy's dairy intolerance (butter or milk in the broth costs a star; not a deal-breaker)
constraints_found.source_line: liam: "oh and roxy, remember the milkshake? my tipster says a lot of carts on that row finish the broth with butter or a splash of milk"

elimination.night_market_bramble_row: $$, one tier over the $ budget, so it loses a star. Otherwise it fits everything. 2 stars.
elimination.night_market_wild_thistle: No peanuts and no dairy, but deep-fried and greasy, which misses Brooke. 2 stars.
elimination.night_market_juniper_yard: $, on the market's peanut-free allergy board, clear broth with bok choy, nothing fried, no dairy. 3 stars.
elimination.night_market_kestrel: No peanuts, $, mostly vegetables and not fried, but the broth is milk with butter on top, which hits Roxy's intolerance. 2 stars.
elimination.night_market_brass_kettle: Peanut sauce, crushed peanuts and peanut dressing. Deal-breaker.
elimination.night_market_sundial: Every bowl starts with roasted peanut oil. Deal-breaker, and a well-hidden trap because the rest of the card looks ideal.

notes: Fair and solvable. Each near miss fails on exactly one constraint, which makes good decoys: Sundial hides peanut oil in an otherwise perfect review, Bramble Row is the hyped stall but costs $$, and Kestrel's milk broth suits Brooke but not Roxy. Two small points. (1) The chat never says whose peanut allergy it is. Liam asks Cyrus to cross off peanut carts and mentions a 'satay incident', so I read it as a group allergy and a deal-breaker. A player might wonder whether it is only a preference, but 'one satay incident was plenty' reads strongly enough. (2) Roxy's dairy issue comes only through the 'remember the milkshake?' callback, so it is implied rather than stated. That is fine for a later level and it only costs one star anyway. Maya's budget line ('break a bill') points to $ well enough. The noodle craving, Liam's 'THE stall' and 'you'll know at the first slurp', does not separate the venues, since all six are noodle carts.
